description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade operations for a device running OpenWrt firmware, including device detection, configuration backup, firmware upgrade procedures for SD boot and NOR flash, and image validation based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs_device
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem device for upgrade, based on current mount info.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Backs up current configuration to an SD card partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade on SD boot devices by writing kernel and root filesystem images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nor
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade on NOR flash, combining kernel and root images into a temporary file, then flashing.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the image based on the board type and current root filesystem device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from backup depending on board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the overall upgrade process based on board type and current device.
